releases.displayName: Update on recent Unity security vulnerability!

items.text: Due to a recently disclosed security vulnerability found in some Unity-built games, we wanted to let you know that we’ve already taken care of it on our side.

There’s no indication that the issue was ever exploited or that anyone was affected, but fixes have already been released - and we applied them right away to ensure that Elderborn are now fully patched and secure.

You don’t need to do anything on your side - just keep your game updated as usual. We’ll continue to monitor the situation and follow the latest security recommendations to keep everything running safe and sound.
Stay safe!
Hyperstrange out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png"]
Today we’re adding localisations for Bulgarian, Estonian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Slovak and Icelandic

As with the previous patch, we’ve used AI based tools, they may contain mistranslations, but we still believe that it is something that might help you dive into the game. As with the previous experimental implementation, let us know if these are to your liking!

To make sure we don't miss any of your voices, we are keeping a separate channel on our Discord, Elderborn-Localisations. There we encourage you to share your thoughts and any mistranslations that you come across. As in the previous update, we vow to fix all the things that you bring to us.
You can find the dedicated discord channel here: https://discord.gg/hyperstrange-494562943204327435
Let’s also quickly reiterate on what was already said previously regarding some questions:
Q: Why aren't we using professional translators?
A: We actively work with many translators. ELDERBORN's budget didn't account for other translations.
Q: Are we planning to replace our translators with AI tools?
A: Absolutely not. Using these tools is to aid in these cases where our resources are limited.

notes.title: Hyperstrange's Massacre Before Christmas Publisher Sale

items.text: Everyone celebrates Christmas their own way: some find joy in baking pies... and smashing heads of anyone who disturbs their holiday spirit. Others care for their holiday tree like it’s sacred, keeping it perfectly watered. There are those who take this time to settle personal scores… umm, I mean, misunderstandings - laying all their cards on the table so they can enjoy a grudge-free holiday.

Our job? Making sure that there are proper presents! So come join us under our Hyperstrange Tree - it might be a little early, a little blood-soaked, and a lot chaotic, but the wicked gifts are already there, waiting for you.

We named this event The Hyperstrange's Massacre Before Christmas and it’s ready to deliver gifts of death-n-glory and gore-packed fun! Allow us to invite you to ZlimBratSki’s stream, where he’ll explain everything!

notes.title: Want a little sneak peek? Alright, it is the season of giving, after all! Here’s what you’ll find out

items.text: All the gritty details about the upcoming Blood West: Dead Man's Promise DLC. Who, what, where, whom, why, and who asked for it. And most importantly: WHEN??

A deep dive into character progression and skills in our new survivorslike, Hordes of Hunger. Learn how to combine abilities and perks that work together to create powerful builds using and prepare yourself for battles against the Horde.
A sack full of trailers and updates on our other games, and maybe even a hint about some sneaky, but generous giveaways.
Gather round, mighty barbarians!

We’re roaring with excitement that ELDERBORN is still surrounded by such a loyal horde, and that you keep returning to our savage Heavy Metal slasher. From this point, we’d also like to give a loud, thunderous welcome to all the new fearless warriors, eager to become merciless slayers and venture into this brutal world to crush skulls and carve their place in history as badass legends.
But let’s put down our spears and hammers for a sec, because we’ve got some news for you today.
We've been hearing your requests to add new languages to ELDERBORN for a while now.
Ever since they first came in, we’ve been wanting to meet those expectations and make sure players who speak these languages can fully immerse themselves in the game.

However, there are some limitations. Some of you suggested that we try using AI tools to bring in these translations, even if just temporarily. After much deliberation, we decided to give this a try, and that’s why we’ve decided to go with this experimental solution.
Today we’re adding localisations for Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, and Korean.

As we’ve used AI based tools, they may contain mistranslations, yet we trust it’s still something that might help you dive into the game. This is why we're treating this as an experimental implementation, and we're counting on your feedback in this matter.

To make sure we don't miss any of your voices, we've prepared a separate channel on our Discord, Elderborn-Localisations, where we'd love to hear your thoughts on this solution and whether the translations are helpful for you. Feel free to let us know if anything seems off, so we can fix it.
Here’s the direct link: https://discord.gg/5MhMjcuT

releases.displayName: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCIS

items.text: It is that time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

notes.title: INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers!

items.text: Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement

items.text: POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude!

Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: 30 march 2023!

notes.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement

items.text: And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!
Fixed mummy bandages sticking out of it's back

Modified low HP blood effect intensity curve, fixed application of it's values to the effect proper: Apologies for these fixes taking so long - finally found the window of opportunity to take a look at those issues.: I'm especially looking for feedback regarding the low HP blood effect after this one.: ~~Schwalbe The Literal Bastard
The sfx's applied to audio when on low health: tweaked. They should be a little less extreme and distracting.: (context: https://steamcommunity.com/app/727850/discussions/1/3187986750493890863/)
Did you know that you could do the ancient spear challenge by smacking the corpse? Well - now that's no longer possible. : ))
Fixes to navmeshes on tower (chapter 2) - Priests should no longer be able to teleport outside the area (or clip into terrain, et caetera)
Cut down a memory usage bloat resulting from optimisation changes; the GPU/CPU performance shouldn't be impacted, the RAM usage improved.
Setting should no longer reset to default due to change in version number
Fixed an oversight in new female voice over

As the Autumn Steam Sale approaches, we bring you news of a long-awaited update, and we've also brought along a friend. We're teaming up with Hedon dev to bring you the Thicc & Brutal Bundle - get ELDERBORN & Hedon Bloodrite together or complete your collection for an EXTRA 20% discount.

As for the update - you should be glad to hear that it includes a complete rework of the way controllers are handled by ELDERBORN. But there's much more to it, scroll below to see the full changelog. And Hedon?
You don't know Hedon? Well... take a look, and see why ELDERBORN and Hedon are a match made in... uh... Valhalla? Hell? Power Metal themepark? Yeah, one of those.

You will notice that the Thicc & Brutal Bundle is not the only bundle featured on the ELDERBORN store page. Make sure to check out the Action Hyper-Pack, a collection of 3 unique Hyperstrange originals - this might be a great opportunity for you to pick up our newest title - RAYZE!

Today's ELDERBORN update is the result of our steady progress towards improving the PC version of the game, while preparing it for the upcoming console launch. It's quite diverse in terms of areas that have been tinkered with. Work has been done here and there - here's a comprehensive list of changes.
Engine Update - the game has been migrated from UNITY 2017 to UNITY 2020, which is an "under the hood" change, that allowed us to address many issues that eluded us before.

NEW CONTROLLER HANDLING SYSTEM IMPLEMENTED: this should allow for better handling of variety of controllers; NOTE: we don't have access to all possible controllers available on market, especially not the obscure ones; IN CASE OF INPUT ISSUES, consult the settings menu - chances are, you need to set up bindings manually. If this happens (or manual binding fails/turns out impossible), please contact us.
PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS in Chapter 2 - city area should perform better now.
Fixed issue of simultaneous use of weapon wheel and character sheet locking the former on screen
Player should no longer be able to accidentaly leap off the towers in chapter 2
Fixed erraneous damage calculation leading to Die Hard skill not always triggering on NG+.
Fixed incorrect achievement completion for "Ok, Boomer".
Limited ways of moving out of bounds in chapter 2
Stalker's projectiles no longer untextured
Baths in Chapter 2 now react to hits according to materials they are made of.
Wanna know more? Please head to our publisher profile and click that FOLLOW button. You can also stay in touch with us via Twitter and there's a sprawling Discord community, we'd love you to join.
That's it for today from us.

releases.displayName: ELDERBORN Boomercore Update is live. Get the game 50% off this week!

items.text: Hyperstrange is hard at work developing the ultimate throwback shooter, POSTAL: Brain Damaged. But that doesn't mean we're not going to keep updating and expanding our beloved Doom-Souls slasher. ELDERBORN might be the eldest child in the family, but that doesn't mean we're kicking them out and setting up a gym in their bedroom. This newest update was intended to increase stability and decrease load times. Regular maintenance. Boooo-ring! So... We've added 4 special rendering modes and an in-game jukebox, to make things FUN! Getting in touch with the game's 1990's DNA, the new display modes are designed to take you back in time to the VHS era. That's why we called the whole thing... the Boomercore Update!
If haven't launch the game yet to check them out, and you're wondering about the specifics, here's the general changelog:
Added in-game Jukebox, so you can pick your favorite tracks during gameplay.
Added Render Modes: "Your dad's VCR", "DMX Drops", "PC 1996", and "Artsy-Fartsy".
Further scene optimization improving loading times
Profile frame updates correctly after removing ng+ saves
Pad sensitivity now framerate independent
Some fixes in pad navigation in menus
normal difficulty now default, instead od ELDERBORN
Default framelimit now 240, was 60
Smaller bug-fixes and optimisation

notes.title: The game is 50% OFF for entire week!

items.text: So that's one more reason, to check it off your wishlist. Tell your friends while you're at it - especially that one friend you used to play Quake with back in 1996, when pixels were large by default and gluten wasn't illegal in 34 states.
Yours,

ELDERBORN has graduated Steam Early Access an entire year ago, and ever since the full release it's gaining momentum, meeting a lot of praise, and making the life of thousands of players around the world a little more badass, thicc, and barbaric. We've made a habit of giving you more, more, and MORE with each ELDERBORN update - small or big - and this time's no different.
To mark the anniversary, here's ELDERBORN Extended Sountrack! This is a soundtrack-only update, but it's so HUGE we're marking it as a 'major update'. Here's why.

With all the added tracks, the album running time is now a little over an hour and a half, and it's all packed to the brim with metal, wailing of Turkish duduk, drums, and electronic beats. We love it so much, that our friends at Ivory Tower Soundworks are here to stay. Not only they made some very unique music and sounds for our CROSSBOW Bloodnight (now also available on Nintendo Switch! - our first game on consoles, yay!), but are also already working on the sick abomination that will become the POSTAL: Brain Damaged OST!

It's been an amazing year for Hyperstrange. We're still very much indie, but we went from a development studio with one game, to development and publishing studio with several titles, and MANY more to come. Wanna know more? Please head to our publisher profile and click that FOLLOW button. You can also stay in touch with us via Twitter and Discord.
Are they nice? Or are they super nice? They will pop up in Steam very soon. And now, onto the full...
The elusive, yet persistant shader bug that caused the Essence Conduits to spawn a "black void" around them was fixed
Persistant controller bug - workaround added (*instructions below)
The female character voiceover in the cut-scenes has been re-recorded
The annoying navigation bug during the last wave of the epilogue will no longer haunt you
Spears will now properly work with the speed stat
Spear collision bugs have been fixed
There are no longer any missing characters in the Hungarian language version
The New Game+ bug with missing weapons is fixed
Unity patch applied

* Some players reported a problem where the plugged in controllers would continuously send errant input to the game. You can now launch the game with a "-kbm" parameter set in the launch options, to force Keyboard+Mouse only mode, and prevent that from happening.

Now, enjoy the game 40% off, and please tell all your friends about it. Our other little bundle of creepy joy - CROSSBOW: Bloodnight is (obviously) also celebrating Halloween with an all-around update and a special sale. And please also check out the very first third-party game to be published by Hyperstrange in early 2021 - EQI, a free, trippy synthwave cyberspace action-puzzle. Please support us by adding it to your wishlist!
This is it, for today. Happy Helloween, and...

releases.displayName: Permadeath update! ELDERBORN now with Ironman Mode and Russian language support

items.text: Warriors! Today is a good day to die. Perma-die. Your continuous support keeps us working on improving ELDERBORN and today marks the addition of a much player-requested feature. As if the game wasn't hard enough (yeah, we know it's not for some of you - hats off!), you wanted to have the option to play with permadeath. As in no respawn. You die, you're dead-dead, and the game removes your save file. Yea, some of you feel THAT cocky. So here it is... Ironman Mode!

This option can only be applied to a new game, so if you want a really hardcore challenge of conduid-filled NG+ and permadeath combined, you need to prove yourself first by completing the base campaign without dying once. The new play mode also comes with an appropriate new achievement to hunt for. Good hunting!

But there's more! Today's update introduces 2 new language packs to ELDERBORN. Players in Russia and Hungaria are now able to enjoy the game in their respective native tongues. This brings us to a total of 8 language versions, including English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Polish, and Hungarian. We'd like to thank the amazing Lostprophet.hu of the Babble Knights translator team for supporting the Hungarian LOC. The Russian version was prepared by Roboto Global.
That's it for today. We'll see you around, as there's much more Hyperstrange news to be excited about in the near future. We'll keep you posted, so stick around!
Yours truly,

The gates of Jurmum, the ancient, mysterious city are now open. ELDERBORN, the metal melee slash `em up, receives its biggest content update yet. The Sun will shine on the brave, once more. Those of you who braved the many dangers of the catacombs, faced the titanic guardian Janus, and survived, can now venture forth into the forlorn streets, squares, and back alleys of the cursed town. This new location greatly expands the playtime and introduces a whole new selection of enemies, secrets, and puzzles.

On top of the new location this update also introduces a brand new graphical user interface, rebalances and adds some polish to the combat, makes the enemies more responsive, and improves the overall player experience by a multitude of smaller and larger tweaks, fixes, and additions.

Yet again, ELDERBORN has changed a lot, as games in early access often do. The game is best enjoyed from the very beginning, so once again - we apologize, but your old save files won't work. But it’s for the best - you’ll see! A lot of the changes are the direct result of the feedback we’ve been getting from you - our fantastic community of players. Thank you, and please keep it coming! With all the new content we’re very anxious to hear from you, so let us know how are you enjoying the first instalment of the city gameplay in this “Call of Jurmum” update.

With the fully-playable city location, we are drawing near the conclusion of our story. Solving the mystery of Jurmum paves the road to ELDERBORN’s grand finale. We’ll tell you more about it soon. For now, answer the Call of Jurmum, warriors! Enjoy the update!
A new stage - the city of Jurmum - has been added to the game with all-new locations, enemies, puzzles, and mini-boss fights
DURING FIGHT Npc positioning is a bit less random. They act less like a mob now.
Damage, hit points and experience values significantly changed across all types of enemies.
The flow of the Janus boss battle has been re-designed - Janus will talk to the player during the fight
New, more buffed character hands model, to make all those hammer swings look more awesome
Mummy behavior changed, it’s more aggressive now.
Small scorpions are weaker but also much faster.
Stone scorpions heal themselves during fight when their hit points reach a certain threshold
Lava scorpions leave pools of fire after they die.
Drowner behavior changed, it’s less aggressive.
NEW NPC: Albino Drowner – stronger version of the drowner with an additional ranged attack
NEW NPC: Berserker – Hight damage and durability, a foe to be feared.
NEW NPC: Stalker – An npc that attacks only when surrounded by allies.
NEW NPC: Firestarter – Fire bomb hurling enemy.
NEW NPC: Assassin – Npc with the ability to teleport behind players back.
NEW NPC: Golden Army Soldier – Golden army solider armed with a two handed sword. All attack zero defense.
NEW NPC: Golden Army Man at Arms – Golden Army Soldier with a spear and an ability to charge.
NEW NPC: Golden Army Artillery – Golden Army Soldier with a strange weapon.
NEW NPC: Golden Army Shieldbearer – Golden Army Soldier with a small shield, they protect the artillery.
NEW NPC: Walking Corpse – Feral among the ferals. The least human of Jurmum citizens.
NEW NPC: Priest – The clergy of Jurmum with the ability to manipulate the elements.
Added a lot of consistency to the combat system. Everything should feel more balanced now.
The user interface has been re-designed (again!), including a brand-new HUD
New skill and stats screen has been added
Added a “Codex” screen where the player can review tutorials, and learn more about the game’s lore, locations, weapons, items, and enemies Added proper Character sheet to the game
The time needed to complete the action of picking up lost sou… essence has been greatly reduced
New music tracks have been introduced to the game and the system handling music and sound effects has been reworked from scratch.
New mid-intro has been added to bridge the Catacombs (dungeon) and Jurmum (city) stages
Game optimization and stability has been greatly improved

At this point, where the majority of content and gameplay is already IN the game, we're looking for your input to help us polish the game and achieve its peak potential. Your feedback and support means THE WORLD to us!
If you like what you see, please leave us a steam review.
If you wish to see ELDERBORN grow, please consider following us on FACEBOOK &TWITTER and posting about us.

Once more we’re diving deep into the core of ELDERBORN to make some game-changing decisions. Some of them you will see at the first glimpse (the user interface paying tribute to FPS hall of fame classics) others need to be experienced to be recognized (new player movement and combat control).

The game is now harder and more demanding but also you get greater control over the character's combat style. When you want to eliminate undead with one precise hit, go with the strength. If you feel that movement is too clumsy you now can level up your speed. Want to tank bigger groups of enemies like a berserker? Resilience is there for you. Yes. You get to progress and build the character's attributes the way you want and get the experience better suited to your play style. The changes in this update are extensive, so we encourage you to start over and experience the game in its new flavor from the very beginning (in fact… we'll just wipe out the saved games, so you don't really have a choice. Sorry!)

Some may wonder, what of the City Content Update that was going to be the next in line, according to our roadmap. Worry not! The City is taking its final form as we speak and you'll get to fight your way through its terraces, alleys, and squares soon enough. But the player feedback you were providing us turned our attention towards game mechanics first. And it would be a poor choice of order if we released a new map with the old mechanics, just to rebalance it for the new features soon after. Yes, the City is well underway, but core gameplay takes priority.

In this update we are breaking some of the limits we've put on ourselves at the beginning of ELDERBORN's development and explore the unknown. This makes your feedback even more important than ever before.
We’ve introduced a graphical interface to make keeping track of your health and other factors easier and to pay a tribute to some old-school metal-hearted shooters we love
Health regen is out by default - do keep track of your health!
Enemy attack can now disrupt your action - be more mindful of their movements!
Hitting your enemies back lets you partially regain your HP loss, and the faster you do it, the more health you get back - strike back quick!
Enemies now drop “essence” and there are "essence cashes" scattered across the environment
Essence fills phials, that you can use to heal yourself
Essence also serves as XP that you can spend it while meditating at the fountains (use the fountain for a second time after saving, to distribute attribute points and unlock skills)
When you die, you drop all the essence you were carrying, but it will remain there and you’ll get one chance to recover it after you respawn at the fountain

Each of the attributes that you can develop, comes with a set of three unique skills - active or passive - that will become unlockable after you bring the attribute to the required level. Two first skills are treated as basic, while the third is considered the ultimate skill in the given tree, and requires unlocking at least one of the basic skills in that tree first. That’s a total of 9 skills giving you the ability to shape your character build in line with your play style.
Charge: Find your balance, build up momentum and launch a charge towards your enemies, breaking their stance, staggering, and hurting them
Rip and tear: Reach down towards a fallen foe, rip their head right off their shoulders, and hurl it violently towards another enemy
Stomp: Launch into the air and drop like a bomb on the heads of your foes launching a shockwave as you reach the ground
Essence hunter: Stop wasting time chasing after essence dropped by slain foes - now you pull essence towards you, over distance
Reflect projectile: Time a parry right to knock a projectile launched by the foe out of its path, and right into your closest enemy
Air dash: Even gravity has no dominion over you! Dashing is now possible even in mid-jump or while falling
Too stubborn to slay: When your health drops to zero and you’d normally die, you get one more chance to kill a foe and thus regain full health
Licking your wounds: If your health is very low, find a safe spot, catch some breath, and slowly regain up to 40% of your HP
Barbaric rage: you speed up, the world slows down, and with every kill you regain some health

This is an important chapter in the development of ELDERBORN, warriors! The game now has more complexity than ever and it’s closer to what we imagined - the embodiment of modern git good gameplay philosophy wrapped up in single-player, old-school, heavy metal, brutal goodness. We’re getting there - this isn’t even our final form, but it’s significantly closer to our ultimate vision. Your feedback and support means THE WORLD to us now.
If you like what you see, please leave us a steam review.
If you wish to see ELDERBORN grow, please consider following us on FACEBOOK, TWITTER, & INSTAGRAM, and posting about us.

To make sure we don't miss any of your voices, we are keeping a separate channel on our Discord, Elderborn-Localisations. There we encourage you to share your thoughts and any mistranslations that you come across. As in the previous update, we vow to fix all the things that you bring to us.

WARRIORS!
The end of January brings you the first Content Update!

With the new Early Access version of ELDERBORN we are introducing a number of new elements. You now have the opportunity to fight General Janus who wants to put you down with his sword. Who is Janus? Our introduction video will give you a glimpse of ELDERBORN's story, but this is only the beginning of what you will learn in the future.

We are looking forward to hearing your opinion on how the game is evolving, as well as how do you find the Janus bossfight - we'd love to know what you think about him, please share your strats with us! Maybe you have any exploits to beat him easily?
